description: A slice of the drum partitioned off with plasterboard that stops short of the glass, racking visible through the gap. The counter is a workshop bench with a chrome front screwed on. On the wall: a rate card, a diagram of unit sizes, and a handwritten list of what may not be stored here, added to in four different pens.

window.description: The curve, from the partition round to the doors, looking out at Sorrel Way and the backs of the towers on the mews. At this height the glass is the only part of the building anybody designed and it is being used as a shopfront.
window.name: the drum glazing

name: Yarrow Works — The Counter
